title: Usher
wikitext: [[Usher]] is a mysterious figure once sighted at [[QuakeWorld only LAN]] in Germany in [[2006]]. While nobody really knows his real name, age, nationality, or clan history it has been assumed that his name is Usher. Similarly to the reptile known as 'chameleon', Usher is able to transform and adapt to his environment, making it very hard to spot him. == Information == [[Image:usher.jpg|right]] * '''Real name:''' Usher * '''Date of birth:''' Unknown * '''Nationality:''' Unknown * '''Current clan:''' Unknown * '''Colors:''' '''  1  ''' ''' 10 ''' (see picture) == Quotes == * "Ich würde ja gerne, aber Konstantin hat die Decke mitgenommen." == External Links == {{chtv}}
